rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Ultra Cleanが年次報告で、売上の10%超を占める2大顧客の1社としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Ultra Clean names Applied Materials as one of its two largest customers

source.label: Ultra Clean Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our two largest revenue customers in fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023 were Applied Materials, Inc. and Lam Research Corporation, each of which accounted for more than 10% of our total revenues in those three years.
source.note: 供給元(UCT)側の開示で、Applied自身の書類には名前が出ていません。
source.note_en: Disclosed by the supplier (UCT); Applied’s own filings do not name it.

relations.text: Applied MaterialsはUltra Cleanの2025年度売上の21.7%を占めた
relations.text_en: Applied Materials accounted for 21.7% of Ultra Clean’s FY2025 revenue

source.label: Ultra Clean Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Lam Research Corporation 37.0 % 31.9 % 34.0 % Applied Materials, Inc. 21.7 22.6 23.4

relations.text: Ichorが年次報告で、2025年の売上が最大の顧客の1社としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Ichor lists Applied Materials among its largest customers by sales in 2025

source.label: Ichor Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have long standing relationships with top tier OEM customers, including Lam Research, Applied Materials, and ASML which were our largest customers by sales in 2025.

relations.text: AtomeraはテンピのApplied MaterialsのCenturaエピタキシャル装置を、Applied Materialsからリースしている
relations.text_en: Atomera leases an Applied Materials Centura epitaxial reactor from Applied Materials, located at its Tempe facility

source.label: Atomera 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: This dual-chamber tool is leased from Applied Materials and is located in a cleanroom in the same facility where we lease office space in Tempe, Arizona.
source.note: 小規模な装置のリースで、Atomera側の開示です。
source.note_en: A small equipment lease, disclosed by Atomera.

relations.text: 2025年4月にBesiの株式9%を取得し、2020年からBesiと一体型のハイブリッドボンディング装置を共同開発
relations.text_en: Bought a 9% stake in Besi in April 2025 and co-develops an integrated hybrid bonding system with it

source.label: Applied Materials 8-K Ex. 99.1 の発表
source.quote: Applied and Besi have been successfully collaborating since 2020, and recently extended their agreement, to co-develop the industry’s first fully integrated equipment solution for die-based hybrid bonding.

relations.text: 市場取引でBesiの発行済み普通株式の9%を取得
relations.text_en: Purchased 9 percent of Besi’s outstanding common stock through market transactions

source.label: Applied Materials 8-K Ex. 99.1 の発表
source.quote: Applied Materials, Inc. today announced it has purchased 9 percent of the outstanding shares of the common stock of BE Semiconductor Industries N.V. (Besi)
source.note: 2025年4月時点の持分で、その後の変動は確認していません。
source.note_en: The stake as of April 2025; later changes are not verified.

relations.text: Lamが年次報告で、成膜(誘電体・金属)とエッチングの主な競合としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lam Research states that Applied Materials is its primary competitor in dielectric and metals deposition and in etch

source.label: Lam Research 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitor in the dielectric and metals deposition market is Applied Materials, Inc.

relations.text: KLAが年次報告で、各製品市場の競合の1社としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: KLA lists Applied Materials among its competitors in each of its product markets

source.label: KLA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In each of our product markets, we have many competitors, including companies such as Applied Materials, Inc., ASML Holding N.V., Hitachi High-Tech Corporation, Lasertec, Inc. and Onto Innovation, Inc.

relations.text: ASMLが年次報告で、パターン形成を補う用途の提供企業の1社としてApplied Materialsを競合に挙げている
relations.text_en: ASML states it competes with providers of patterning-enhancing applications such as Applied Materials

source.label: ASML 20-F / Annual Report(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with providers of applications that support or enhance complex patterning solutions, such as Applied Materials Inc. and KLA-Tencor Corporation.
source.note: 競合はパターン形成を補う用途に限られます。
source.note_en: Competition is limited to patterning-enhancing applications.

relations.text: Axcelisが年次報告で、イオン注入装置で主にApplied Materialsと競合すると記載
relations.text_en: Axcelis states it mainly competes against Applied Materials in ion implantation systems

source.label: Axcelis Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the market for ion implantation systems, we mainly compete against Applied Materials, Inc. (“Applied Materials”).

companies.name: Veeco Instruments
companies.sub: 成膜・エッチング装置

relations.text: Veecoが年次報告で、主な競合の1社としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Veeco lists Applied Materials among its principal competitors

source.label: Veeco Instruments 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include: Aixtron; Applied Materials; Canon;

relations.text: ACM Researchが年次報告で、PECVD・Track製品の主な競合の1社としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: ACM Research lists Applied Materials among principal competitors for its PECVD and Track products

source.label: ACM Research 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Principal competitors for our PECVD and Track products also include Lam Research Corporation, Applied Materials, Inc., and Suzhou Jingtuo Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd .

companies.name: PDF Solutions
companies.sub: 製造データ解析ソフト

relations.text: PDF Solutionsが年次報告で、半導体製造ソフトと工程内検査・計測装置の競合としてApplied Materialsを挙げている
relations.text_en: PDF Solutions names Applied Materials as a competing provider of semiconductor manufacturing software and inline inspection/metrology equipment

source.label: PDF Solutions 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: semiconductor manufacturing software, such as Applied Materials, Inc (“Applied Materials”), Synopsys, Invantest, Inc., Emerson Electric Co., Onto, and Siemens AG;
source.note: ソフトと検査の分野での重なりです。

relations.text: Novaが年次報告で、工程内センサー・計測製品を開発する装置メーカー(Applied Materialsなど)と競合すると記載
relations.text_en: Nova states it competes with process equipment makers such as Applied Materials that develop in-situ sensors and metrology products

source.label: Nova 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In addition, we compete with process equipment manufacturers, such as ASML Holdings N.V., LAM Research, and Applied Materials Inc., which develop (or may acquire companies which develop) in-situ sensors and metrology products.
source.note: 工程内センサー・計測分野での重なりです。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
